note: Starter Scots law test set, written by the planner from authorities checked on legislation.gov.uk and the law reports (5-6 Nov 2026). Format copied from Harvey LAB: each question has a rubric; an answer passes only if every item passes. 'all' = every phrase must appear; 'any' = at least one of the phrases; 'none' = none may appear. Matching ignores case.

questions.q: Is a company a separate legal person from its members? Name the leading case with its citation.
Can a private limited company in Scotland have only one director? Give the statutory section.
Is a partnership in Scotland a legal person? Give the statute and section.
How many members are needed to incorporate an LLP? Give the statute.
When can a careless statement lead to liability in delict? Name the leading case with its citation.
Can an unqualified company give immigration advice in the UK? Give the statute and section.
If a company commits the offence of giving unlawful immigration advice, can its director be guilty too? Give the section.
Can a business send a marketing email to a sole trader who never consented? Give the regulation.
Under the Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations 2003, is a Scottish partnership a corporate subscriber?
A Scottish landlord never protected a tenant's deposit. How long after the tenancy ends can the tenant apply to the tribunal, and what must the tribunal order?
